ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.description: Careerly uses your own API key from the AI provider. It is stored encrypted on this computer and never shown again.
ai.desktopOnly: The API key is set up from the desktop app.

ai.statusError: The key status could not be read: {{message}}
ai.noSecureStorage: This system has no secure password storage, so the key cannot be saved safely. On Linux, install and unlock a keyring (for example GNOME Keyring or KWallet).
ai.removeDescription: It is deleted from this computer. If it was the one in use, AI features are disabled until you add another.
ai.invalidFormat: The key does not look valid (no spaces, at least 10 characters).

ai.unreachable: {{provider}} could not be reached to verify the key (offline?). It may be fine.

backups.title: Backups and data
backups.description: Export all your data (profile, applications, generated resumes) to a single file and restore it on this or another computer.
backups.personalDataWarning: The file contains your personal data: keep it somewhere safe. Your API key is never included.
backups.listEmpty: You have not exported any backup yet.
backups.restoreDescription: All your current data is replaced by the backup. A copy of the current state is saved in the data folder first.
backups.deleteDescription: Deletes your profile, applications, generated resumes, backups and API keys from this computer.
backups.deleteConfirmDescription: Your master profile, applications, generated resumes, every backup and your API keys are deleted. This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you want to keep anything.

aiModels.title: AI models
aiModels.description: Choose the model for each kind of task. If the chosen one stops existing, Careerly goes back to the default models.
aiModels.loading: Looking up the models available to your key…

small.label: Small model
small.hint: For extracting and scoring (reading a CV, analyzing a job posting). A fast, cheap one works best.

large.label: Large model
large.hint: For writing the tailored resume. The best quality one works best.

aiModels.selectedUnavailable: The chosen model ({{model}}) is no longer available: the default models are used.
aiModels.useDefaults: Go back to the default model
aiModels.savedDefaults: Done: the default model ({{model}}) is used.

errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: Set up an API key to choose the models.
errors.AI_KEY_REJECTED: The provider rejected the API key. Check it in the section above.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: The provider's usage limit was reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the AI provider. Check your connection.
errors.AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The model is not available to your key (it does not exist or is overloaded). It was not saved.
errors.AI_FAILED: The model did not answer in the format Careerly needs. It was not saved.

claudeCode.title: Claude with your subscription
claudeCode.description: Uses the Claude Code installed on this computer, with your Claude plan, instead of an API key. For personal use only: it uses your plan limits and each call takes a few more seconds, because Claude Code starts.
claudeCode.loadError: Claude Code could not be checked: {{message}}
claudeCode.ready: Claude Code {{version}} installed and signed in ({{authMethod}}).

problems.NOT_INSTALLED: Claude Code was not found on this computer. Install it from claude.com/claude-code and check again.

problems.CHECK_FAILED: Claude Code did not answer the check. Try again in a while.

claudeCode.enabledNote: While it is on, Careerly uses Claude Code for AI even if you have an API key saved.
claudeCode.safety: It runs locked down: no tools except reading the file being analyzed, none of your MCP servers or settings, and no saved session.

import.title: Import a CV
import.subtitle: The AI reads your CV and drafts your profile. You review it, fix whatever needs fixing, and only then is it saved.

telemetry.title: Help us improve Careerly
telemetry.description: Choose which usage statistics to share. Nothing is sent until you answer.

consent.intro: With your permission, Careerly sends an anonymous usage summary once a day. Uncheck anything you do not want to share.
consent.newMetrics: This version adds new statistics. What you already chose does not change: we only ask about these.

activeUsage.name: Active use
activeUsage.description: Whether you used the app that day (yes or no).

applications.name: Number of applications
applications.description: How many applications you created that day.

sources.name: Job boards
sources.description: Which job board each posting came from (e.g. linkedin.com). Never the full URL.

positionCategories.name: Category and seniority
positionCategories.description: Role type and level of each posting (e.g. senior backend).

positionTitles.name: Position titles
positionTitles.description: The title of the posting, cut to 80 characters.

funnel.name: Status funnel
funnel.description: How many applications moved to each status (interview, offer…).

workModeAndCountry.name: Work mode and country
workModeAndCountry.description: Remote, hybrid or on-site, and the country of the posting.

features.name: Feature usage
features.description: How many resumes you generated and in which languages, how many gaps you answered and the AI tokens used.

neverSent.title: Never sent
neverSent.resume: Your resume or your master profile.
neverSent.personal: Your name, email, phone or any other personal data.
neverSent.companies: Company names, contacts, notes or salaries.
neverSent.jobPostings: The text or the full URL of job postings.
neverSent.ai: Prompts, AI responses or your API key.

telemetry.retention: Reports are daily, carry an anonymous ID you can regenerate, and are kept with no time limit.

guide.title: How to write a template
guide.download: Download the starting point: the built-in template and the example CVs in Spanish and English.
guide.data: The template gets everything in a single JSON, with the section titles already translated: there is nothing to translate.
guide.test: Try it with Typst from the unpacked folder:
guide.upload: Upload it here. It is saved only if it builds both examples.
guide.ats: For applicant tracking systems (ATS) to read the CV: a single column, standard section titles, selectable text, no letter spacing in titles and no text in images. The app cannot fully check this.
